Both letters explain why piecemeal treatment is inadequate, announce the creation by Executive order of a temporary presidential policy body, ask the recipient to serve as chairman, impose a final-report deadline, restate the body's enumerated mandate from the establishing order, identify priority subjects for study, and close by emphasizing national importance. Several passages share unusually close wording and sequencing, with communications substituted for water resources. C09 supplies the underlying commission machinery reflected in C16 but is less directly a template for the child's letter. C13 shares comprehensive-policy and study-commission concepts but not the child's distinctive letter structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Problems such as these cannot adequately be considered on a piecemeal basis. They must be viewed as parts of the broader problem of developing a total national communications policy","parent_excerpt":"In many cases, piece-meal or partial approaches to a problem as broad as water resources development tend to confuse, rather than clarify, many of the basic, underlying issues. It is essential in my judgment that a comprehensive study and review be made","explanation":"Both use the inadequacy of piecemeal treatment to justify a comprehensive national-policy review."},{"child_excerpt":"I am therefore establishing by Executive order a temporary Communications Policy Board of 5 members to study and to make recommendations to me on the policies and practices which should be followed by the Federal Government","parent_excerpt":"Therefore, I am creating by Executive order a temporary Water Resources Policy Commission of seven members to study and to make recommendations to me on the policies which should be followed by the Federal Government","explanation":"This is near-verbatim, distinctive language announcing the same institutional mechanism, adapted to a different policy field."},{"child_excerpt":"I am asking you to serve as Chairman of this Board. In view of the need for early action in this field, I should like to receive the Board's final report by no later than October 31, 1950.","parent_excerpt":"I am asking you to serve as chairman of this Commission. Because of the need for early action in the field of water resources development, I am requesting the Commission to submit its final report to me not later than December 1, 1950.","explanation":"The appointment request, early-action rationale, and report deadline follow the same wording and sequence."},{"child_excerpt":"The Executive order establishing this Board states that the Board shall study...
